# opnsense_bind_forward_domain (Resource)

Manages a forward-only BIND zone inside a selected view.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "opnsense_bind_forward_domain" "corp" {
  view_id         = opnsense_bind_view.internal.id
  domain_name     = "corp.example.net"
  forward_servers = ["10.10.0.53", "10.10.0.54"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `domain_name` (String)
- `forward_servers` (Set of String)
- `view_id` (String)

### Optional

- `allow_query_acl_ids` (Set of String)
- `enabled` (Boolean)

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
